title: Fourteen years of the bond's coupon rate
alt: Housing and Urban Fund notice listing every First-Class National Housing Bond interest rate change from 2012 to 2026
note: The full run of rate changes as the fund publishes them: 3.00% until July 2012, down through 1.00% by August 2019, up to 1.30% in December 2022, back to 1.00% from April 2025. This is the coupon the bond pays — not the discount you take when selling it on the day, which moves with market yields and is the number that actually leaves your account.
redaction: Nothing removed. A public notice page, no personal or business information.
